title: a room-booking table keyed by (room, during WITHOUT OVERLAPS), and four bookings to try

steps.sql:
CREATE TABLE bookings (
  room   int       NOT NULL,
  guest  text      NOT NULL,
  during daterange NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (room, during WITHOUT OVERLAPS)
);
INSERT INTO bookings VALUES (101, 'ada', '[2026-03-02,2026-03-05)'), (101, 'grace', '[2026-03-05,2026-03-07)')
steps.note: bookings keyed by room and stay. the key is checked for overlap, not equality.
edsger wants room 101 from march 4 to 6. that overlaps both stays, and the key refuses it.

error.message: conflicting key value violates exclusion constraint "bookings_pkey"
error.detail: Key (room, during)=(101, [2026-03-04,2026-03-06)) conflicts with existing key (room, during)=(101, [2026-03-02,2026-03-05)).

steps.note: the same dates in room 102: a different key, no conflict.

steps.sql: SELECT room, guest, during FROM bookings ORDER BY room, lower(during)

steps.note: room 101 from march 7, the day grace leaves. half-open ranges touch without overlapping.
